title: rosa rubella subsp. mediterranea
intro: Rosa rubella subsp. mediterranea, commonly known as the Mediterranean Rose, is a subspecies of wild rose that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rubella subsp. mediterranea include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, and they also exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer activities.
